description: Hourly electricity consumption record, gold table gold_hourly_consumption (Developer A -> B and C)

fields.timestamp: Start of the hour, ISO 8601 without timezone, e.g. 2008-01-15T18:00:00. Every hour in the range is present, including hours with no data.
fields.global_active_power_kwh: float, total energy used in that hour in kWh. Null when complete is false.
fields.sub_metering_1_kwh: float, kitchen, kWh. Null when complete is false.
fields.sub_metering_2_kwh: float, laundry, kWh. Null when complete is false.
fields.sub_metering_3_kwh: float, water heater and AC, kWh. Null when complete is false.
fields.minutes_recorded: integer 0-60, how many minutes of that hour have valid readings
fields.complete: boolean, true only when all 60 minutes have valid readings

unit_conversion.global_active_power_kwh: sum of the 60 per-minute Global_active_power values (kW) / 60
unit_conversion.sub_metering_kwh: sum of the 60 per-minute Sub_metering values (Wh) / 1000
